package.name: sensor_fault_injection
package.description:
Sensor Fault Injection Package for VRX USV Simulation.
Provides configurable fault injection for multiple sensors to test fault diagnosis algorithms in maritime environments.
Supported Sensors and Fault Types: - GPS: Outage/Dropout, Jump/Step Error, Stuck-at-Fault, Multipath - IMU: Stuck-at-Fault, Saturation
package.author: USV Fault Injection Research
